VAR-weight.why: Household-level weight variable labeled 'Weight' in rt001.

VAR-intmonth.why: String 'Date' field at household level; may contain interview/visit date from which interview month could be derived.
Additional household-level 'Date' string field; could alternatively carry interview/visit date for deriving month.

VAR-intyear.why: String 'Date' field at household level; may contain interview/visit date from which interview year could be derived.
Additional household-level 'Date' string field; could alternatively carry interview/visit date for deriving year.

VAR-year.why: If this is the interview/visit date, survey year (or start year) can be taken/derived from it.
Alternate household-level date field that may support deriving the survey year.
